Baba's must do better
Jun 2026 • Family
Well this was a very disappointing return to Baba's. We had ordered the food for a 7pm delivery but arrived 20minutes early and cold! Not a great start!

But in general the food lacked flavour and spice. It was just rather tasteless. Presumeably the spice master had the night off?! At a 30% premium we were expecting so much more. So we have learnt our lesson and will return to Pranaam Bharat where the food is so flavoursome and better value.

We were sold short with the fish tikka, the portion being less than advertised. Once we had pointed out their indiscretion, Baba's were very quick to rectify and immediately sent round another portion. A great response!

She apologized and another server came over to apologize and asked me if I wanted another beer but with my pants now soaked I wanted to just go home and get out of my wet clothes. Worse curry ever
Oct 2022 • Family
Looking forward to an authentic curry. We had tandoori vegetables which were basically so covered in spice powder and fried, powder coating so thick that's all you could taste. We had vegetable korma and a spinach and potato curry, they were served in silver buckets, presentation was appalling but the worst thing was the taste. They both tasted the same, just like a garlic sauce, no hint of spices or curry taste just a thick garlic flavour. The rice was mediocre, naan and paratha was the only edible item. 
Avoid

Cozy ambiance and great food!
Jun 2022 • Family
Baba’s kitchen is our family’s absolute favorite restaurant in Ho Chi Minh city.My 6 year old son demands to go there every weekend, he loves their chicken starters, chicken curry and Kerala paratha, and happily sings - “food is yummy in my tummy”. The best part is that their menu is extensive and have variety of options for both vegetarians and non vegetarians. It’s definitely one of the busiest restaurants in HCMC, but the staff always make us feel welcome and give us an amazing experience.The ambiance too is very refreshing and charming.Love this place! Highly recommend!
